entries.answer:
toml
entrypoint = "main.py"
language = "python3"
hidden = [".venv", "__pycache__", ".pytest_cache", "build"]
build = "bash -eu -o pipefail -c 'python3 -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check exo-lang==1.0.0'"
run = ["bash", "-eu", "-o", "pipefail", "-c", ".venv/bin/exocc main.py -o build --stem main"]

[agent]
expertMode = true

[nix]
channel = "stable-23_11"

[gitHubImport]
requiredFiles = [".replit", "replit.nix"]

[packager]
language = "python3"
ignoredPaths = [".venv", "build"]

[packager.features]
guessImports = false
packageSearch = true
enabledForHosting = false

[run.env]
PYTHONUNBUFFERED = "1"
PYTHONNOUSERSITE = "1"
CMAKE_GENERATOR = "Ninja"


nix
{ pkgs }: {
  deps = [
    pkgs.python311
    pkgs.gcc
    pkgs.cmake
    pkgs.ninja
    pkgs.git
    pkgs.pkg-config
    pkgs.z3
  ];
}
